name: Spectral Clustering
learningObjectives: Learn to handle non-convex cluster shapes

controls.label: Number of Clusters (k)
controls.tooltip: Number of clusters to find using spectral clustering.

controls.label: Affinity Type
controls.tooltip: Method for constructing the affinity matrix.

controls.label: Gamma
controls.tooltip: Kernel coefficient for RBF and polynomial kernels. Higher values create more localized similarities.

controls.label: Number of Neighbors
controls.tooltip: Number of neighbors for nearest neighbors affinity (only used when affinity is 'nearest_neighbors').

visualizations.title: Spectral Clustering (Original Space)
visualizations.description: Scatter plot showing data points in original space colored by spectral cluster assignment

visualizations.title: Spectral Embedding
visualizations.description: Scatter plot showing data points in the spectral embedding space where K-Means is applied

metrics.name: Silhouette Score
metrics.description: Measures how similar points are to their own cluster vs other clusters (range: -1 to 1, higher is better)

metrics.name: Cluster Sizes
metrics.description: Number of points assigned to each cluster

metrics.name: Eigenvalues
metrics.description: Eigenvalues of the Laplacian matrix used for spectral embedding

metrics.name: Spectral Gap
metrics.description: Difference between k-th and (k+1)-th eigenvalues, indicates cluster separability

metrics.name: Affinity Type
metrics.description: Method used to construct the affinity matrix

metrics.name: Laplacian Type
metrics.description: Type of Laplacian matrix normalization used
